firstPlayerRule: Give the initiative marker to a randomly chosen player. The player with initiative takes the first turn of the opening round.
clarifications: The rulebook names no particular way to choose randomly.
This is the base-game setup; Leaders & Lore and The Blighted Reach are separate modes or expansions.
